test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A train running at 90 km/h crosses an electric pole in 18 seconds and a platform in 65 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
solution:
Given:

A train running at 90 km/h crosses an electric pole in 18 seconds and a platform in 65 seconds.

Concept used:

1m/s = 18/5 km/h

While a train crosses a platform, it crosses the sum of its length and the length of the platform

While a train crosses an electric pole, it crosses its own length.

Calculation:

Let the length of the platform be P meters.

90 kmph = 90 ÷ 18/5 = 25 meters per second (mps)

Hence, the length of the train = 25 × 18 = 450 meters.

According to the question,

25 × 65 = (450 + Q)

⇒ 1625 = 450 + Q

⇒ Q = 1175

∴ The length of the platform is 1175 m.
